post.description: Validate and atomically persist the pinned answer/transition and deduplicated server milestones. V1/V2 remain unchanged. V3 confirms a private sample report once, returns only teaser before mock unlock, persists countdown/unlock/upsell, and completes a selected final. Identical retries restore current state; no financial data accepted. See V3.md.

post.summary: Record an actual visible screen exposure
post.description: CSRF protected; max 4096 bytes; independent 40/minute session rate limit. Retry with the same UUID. Server milestones, identity, configuration, attribution, variant and synthetic flag are forbidden inputs. Views deduplicate semantically by landing visitor/experiment or run/screen, including different UUIDs. Accepted duplicate IDs are no-ops, including IDs reused for another screen. This response does not prove a new insertion. Bootstrap first for landing.

get.summary: Synthetic aggregate sample for the last seven days
get.description: Hard-coded synthetic dataset, rolling [now-7 days,now) UTC cohort, asOf=now, 24-hour observation. All query parameters are rejected (422). No raw IDs, answers, attribution, admin details, or real data. Private/no-store even though aggregate-only. Uses the shared AggregateService and definitions in docs/ANALYTICS.md.

200.description: Aggregate-only illustrative sample; zero denominators have null rates

post.summary: Permanently delete the current anonymous visitor data and rotate its session
post.description: Server session ownership only; requires CSRF. Deletes own run/result/answers and events including landing exposure. Preserves administrators and other visitors. Empty object only, no query parameters.

200.description: Deleted; a fresh anonymous session cookie and CSRF token are returned

disclaimer.const: Illustrative demo values — not calculated from your answers.

FunnelConfiguration.description: Published only after validating IDs, parameters, reachable enabled screens, targets, acyclicity and both complete paths. Disabled screens follow their default next. Tutorial incorrect branch must lead to a guided explanation and rejoin its default path. Result leads to boundary; only boundary leads to done. Runtime array order does not determine progression.

Answer.description: Server chooses the shape by pinned screen type: cells for tutorial/memory (bounded by grid_size), choice from pattern options, exact permutation of logic card IDs, acknowledged:true for content/result/boundary. Empty cells are accepted. No client next or branch assertion.

ClientEvent.description: Landing: omit run_id/step_id. Other names require an owned run and current or previously completed screen; name must match screen type. All context and timestamps come from the server. V3 paywall and checkout exposures match paywall; report exposure requires an unlocked final. Each event name has a separate semantic identity. No email/financial fields.

current_step.description: Canonical screen ID or done. Historical T1 result is terminal without a boundary.

answers.description: Owner-only canonical saved responses, keyed by completed screen ID.

demo_completed.description: True only after a v2 boundary acknowledgement. Historical T1 result remains a completed memory preview.
